title: Divisibility Rules from 2 to 13: Table, Worked Examples and Why They Work
seoDescription: Divisibility rules for 2 to 13 with a checked example each, why they work, the correct tricks for 7 and 13, and where NCERT Class 6 and 8 cover them.
excerpt: One table with a verified example for every divisor from 2 to 13, plus the place-value reasons behind each rule, the 4 and 6 trap, and the NCERT chapters where CBSE students meet these tests.
